sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. PACE and LACUNA were already live on origin/data, so the main agent selected the clean first-ranked candidate Epistemic Goggles.
Main agent read the arXiv PDF, official code README, Hugging Face artifact card, and external search results, extracting method, training objective, results, ablations, and limitations.
Markdown uses TL;DR, claim-mechanism-evidence-boundary table, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, result tables, and explicit limitation analysis.
